## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 417 captures during April 2026. Activity continued across the reporting month, with completed image capture supporting the routine grading pathway. The recorded total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the site.

## Image quality

A total of 21 captures were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.0. The result should continue to be monitored through routine quality review, including consideration of any recurring issues affecting image acquisition. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 136 referable results recorded during April 2026. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This measure provides an overview of the timeliness of the grading process during the month. The site should continue its established monitoring of referral volumes, image quality and grading turnaround to support consistent service delivery.
